tagline: A one-word command that turns a whole Claude Code project into a plain-English page you can text to somebody.
summary: Everett types one word in his AI coding tool and it turns a whole project into a page like this one. He texts the link. You're caught up in a minute instead of a phone call.
goal: Nobody ever has to be caught up by text message again.
